panels.title: RTT (ms) by Target
panels.description: Mean RTT per target aggregated by time window.

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "netprobe_icmp" and r._field == "rtt_ms")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.target =~ /${target}/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: min, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "min")

from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "netprobe_icmp" and r._field == "rtt_ms")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.target =~ /${target}/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "avg")

from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "netprobe_icmp" and r._field == "rtt_ms")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.target =~ /${target}/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "max")

panels.title: Current Packet Loss (%)
panels.description: Last observed loss_pct for the selected targets.

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "netprobe_icmp" and r._field == "loss_pct")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.target =~ /${target}/)
  |> last()

panels.title: RTT p95 (ms)
panels.description: 95th percentile of RTT per target over time.

panels.title: Last Snapshot (RTT & Loss)
panels.description: Per-target last values for RTT and packet loss.

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: -10m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "netprobe_icmp" and (r._field == "rtt_ms" or r._field == "loss_pct"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.target =~ /${target}/)
  |> group(columns: ["target", "_field"]) 
  |> last()
  |> pivot(rowKey:["_time"], columnKey:["_field"], valueColumn:"_value")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "target", "rtt_ms", "loss_pct"])

panels.title: Top 10 by Loss (mean over last 15m)
panels.description: Targets with highest average loss over the last 15 minutes.

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: -15m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "netprobe_icmp" and r._field == "loss_pct")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.target =~ /${target}/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["target"]) 
  |> last()
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 10)
